cd /app/submission && python3 - << 'PY'
import main
fieldmap={'bytes':{'index':0,'type':'SIZE','min':0,'max':100},'packets':{'index':1,'type':'COUNT','min':0,'max':100},'f':{'index':2,'type':'FLAG'},'id':{'index':3,'type':'ID','values':{'x','y'}}}
# rows oldest..newest
rows=[[10,5,True,'x'],[30,7,False,'y']]
# mean bytes 0..1 = 20 > 10
a={"cmp":"gt","left":{"aggregate":"mean","field":"bytes","from":0,"to":1},"right":{"const":10,"type":"SIZE"}}
print('mean gt10', main.eval_atom(a,rows,fieldmap))
# sum > 41
b={"cmp":"gt","left":{"aggregate":"sum","field":"bytes","from":0,"to":1},"right":{"const":41,"type":"SIZE"}}
print('sum>41',main.eval_atom(b,rows,fieldmap))
# any over $ packets >=7 
q={"quantifier":"any","from":0,"to":1,"predicate":{"cmp":"ge","left":{"field":"packets","at":"$"},"right":{"const":7,"type":"COUNT"}}}
print('any packets>=7',main.eval_atom(q,rows,fieldmap))
# all bytes lt 31
qa={"quantifier":"all","from":0,"to":1,"predicate":{"cmp":"lt","left":{"field":"bytes","at":"$"},"right":{"const":31,"type":"SIZE"}}}
print('all bytes<31',main.eval_atom(qa,rows,fieldmap))
# add (bytes+packets) eq const 15 type SIZE
c={"cmp":"eq","left":{"add":[{"field":"bytes","at":0},{"field":"packets","at":0}]},"right":{"const":15,"type":"SIZE"}}
print('add eq15',main.eval_atom(c,rows,fieldmap))
# scale 2*bytes > 59
d={"cmp":"gt","left":{"scale":2,"term":{"field":"bytes","at":1}},"right":{"const":59,"type":"SIZE"}}
print('2*30>59',main.eval_atom(d,rows,fieldmap))
